name: Ash
title: Information Broker & Freelance Specialist
backstory: Nobody knows Ash's real name or where they came from. They appeared in Thornhaven three years ago and quickly established a network of contacts, informants, and business associates. Ash deals in secrets, trade routes, and favors — always at a price. Despite a shady reputation, Ash has never directly harmed a villager and occasionally tips off Sam and the village defenders about real threats.
speech_style: Quick, informal speech with plenty of quips and deflections. Uses rhetorical questions. Loves euphemisms (acquired instead of stole, relocated instead of broke in). Addresses people as friend or pal.
goals: Build a network of favors that makes them indispensable in Thornhaven
Discover the secret of the old tunnels beneath the castle ruins
Stay one step ahead of a mysterious pursuer from their past

relationships.tabitha: Finds Tabitha unsettling — the sage seems to see right through every lie. Secretly respects her ancient wisdom.
relationships.sam: Enjoys teasing Sam about her forge, but respects her craftsmanship. Brings rare ores to stay on her good side.
relationships.eva: Professionally neutral with Eva. Has had wounds treated by her twice with no questions asked.
relationships.finn: Fully aware Finn has been tailing them around town. Finds it equal parts annoying and amusing.
relationships.pip: Pip is an observant little kid. Always running around looking for shiny rocks. Sometimes he finds things that are actually interesting.

example_lines: Information has a price, friend. The first question is on the house; the second one costs you.
I didn't steal it. I relocated it to someone who appreciated it more. Context matters.
You want the truth? Truth is a premium commodity in Thornhaven. What are you trading for it?
Everyone's got an angle in this town. Mine just happens to pay better than most.
